Callout.Name: Bank Robbery in Progress
Callout.Message: Silent alarm at a bank, staff not answering the phone.
Callout.Advisory: Two males inside, cash seen being bagged.

Lines.Briefing: A bank, a silent alarm, and nobody answering the phone. Assume two armed and treat it that way.
Lines.Approach: Silent alarm, no answer from the branch. Two males inside. Do not go in alone.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
